name: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears

aliases: mercy falls on deaf ears quest
faq.answer: The Nightclaw enclave offers coin and deeper trust to those who kill Al'Aketh cultists and bring back their ears. The survivors seek vengeance after a terrible tragedy.
faq.q: What is Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are a sect of accursed cultists whose actions have brought ruin and tragedy to neighboring settlements. They operate across the Gustberry Lowlands, Shadowgale Forest, and the Shrine of Akir, provoking blood feuds with the people of those lands.
Al'Aketh cultists can be found in Shadowgale Forest, around the Shrine of Akir, and throughout the Gustberry Lowlands. The Nightclaw seek proof from those who kill them.
faq.q: Where can Al'Aketh cultists be found?

aliases: why do they want cultist ears
faq.answer: The Nightclaw demand cultist ears as proof that their enemies are dead. After a severe tragedy at the Al'Aketh's hands, the enclave seeks vengeance and proof for every bounty paid.
faq.q: Why does the quest giver collect cultist ears?

faq.answer: The Nightclaw are a secretive enclave that has suffered heavy losses at the hands of the Al'Aketh. They guard their lore closely, but promise outsiders access to their mysteries if they prove their loyalty by fighting the cultists.

The Al'Aketh caused a great tragedy for the Nightclaw enclave, sparking an uncompromising blood feud. The bounty gives no details of the incident or its casualties, but the survivors demand total vengeance.
faq.q: What tragedy did the Al'Aketh cause?

faq.answer: The Nightclaw keep their secrets within the enclave and do not reveal them to outsiders at once. They promise access to this hidden knowledge to those who keep aiding their fight against the Al'Aketh and prove themselves true friends.

sections.body: The Nightclaw enclave and the Al'Aketh cultists are locked in a bitter feud. A terrible tragedy has left the survivors with no hope of peace. They seek vengeance for their fallen kin and turn to wandering adventurers and mercenaries for help. The enclave offers coin and the promise of deeper trust to those who kill cultists and bring back their ears as proof.
sections.title: Blood for Blood

sections.body: The Al'Aketh spread their influence through the Gustberry Lowlands, Shadowgale Forest, and the ancient Shrine of Akir. Their dark practices and fanatical ways have earned the hatred of local inhabitants. Striking the cult's camps across these lands can weaken its reach and earn favor with the secretive Nightclaw. The enclave keeps its mysteries close until an outsider proves their loyalty.
sections.title: The Al'Aketh Menace

summary: In the wilds around Shadowgale Forest, the Nightclaw survivors seek vengeance against the Al'Aketh. After a terrible tragedy at the cultists' hands, they offer coin and a promise of access to their hidden lore for trophies taken from slain enemies. Their feud now reaches across Shadowgale Forest and the surrounding territories.
attribution: In-game quest text: Mercy Falls on Deaf Ears
